cli.reason: CLI commands and shared wire contracts remain compatible; this release preserves original Agent error details and corrects the macOS Service job classification.

service.reason: Existing cloud clients accept the same lifecycle and bounded originalError fields; older Services remain compatible and retain explicit failure outcomes. No runtime contract or minimum version changes.

skills.reason: The Skills contract now requires explicit recipient flags matching the new CLI command contract. Update Skills with the CLI; older signed revisions remain available to their matching legacy contract.
